description: This file handles the deletion of a 'ProjectTask' bean in a SugarCRM/SuiteCRM environment. It retrieves a 'ProjectTask' record based on the request parameters, checks permissions, marks the record as deleted, and redirects to a specified location.

classes.description: Handles Access Control List permissions and displays no-access notices.
